sig: [[["A", "Hello, this is a message for Linh Nguyen. My name is Karen Wells, and I'm a recruiter at Talent Bridge."], ["A", "Thank you for applying for the senior backend developer position with our client, Orbit Payments."], ["A", "I'm happy to let you know that they were very impressed with your application."], ["A", "They'd like to invite you to a first-round interview by video call."], ["A", "The interview will last about forty-five minutes and will be with two members of their engineering team."], ["A", "They've suggested either Tuesday at two p.m. or Thursday at ten a.m., Vietnam time."], ["A", "Please let me know which time works better for you by end of day tomorrow."], ["A", "You'll also be asked to solve a short coding problem during the call, so make sure you have a laptop with a working camera."], ["A", "After the interview, I'll follow up with feedback within a few days."], ["A", "You can reply to my e-mail or call me back at 555-0147."], ["A", "Congratulations on getting this far, and I look forward to hearing from you."]], {"A": "F-US"}]
